nodes.label: Walking & locomotion patterns
nodes.text: Walks, runs and moves in set patterns: alternate feet, on a line/zig-zag/circle, tiptoe, sideways/backwards, on knees.

nodes.label: Static balance & posture
nodes.text: Holds balance on one/alternate feet, balancing board or beam; sits criss-cross; core strength for sitting posture.

nodes.label: Jumping & hopping
nodes.text: Jumps and lands on two feet, on the spot, in/out of a circle and place to place.

nodes.label: Stair climbing range
nodes.text: Climbs stairs, progressing from 5-10 stairs to 20-30 stairs with alternating feet.

nodes.label: Ball skills: throw, kick, catch, roll
nodes.text: Throws overhand, rolls, kicks with direction/towards a target, catches a bouncing ball.

nodes.label: Body control & spatial negotiation
nodes.text: Controls body when running/moving; negotiates hurdles and obstacles; stops, changes speed and direction promptly; runs start to finish.

nodes.label: Fundamental movement repertoire
nodes.text: Combined movement checklist (hop, jump, crawl, climb, stamp, push/pull, stand-sit, carry bag and move).

nodes.label: Dominant hand / leg preference
nodes.text: Observed laterality (hand and leg preference); recorded, not scored.

nodes.label: Hand & finger isolation
nodes.text: Moves hands and fingers without moving the shoulder; rolls a pencil between thumb and fingers (in-hand manipulation).

nodes.label: Pouring liquids
nodes.text: Holds a cup; holds and pours from a water bottle/cup; pours water from one container to another.

nodes.label: Transferring & scooping (spoon, sponge, tongs)
nodes.text: Scoops sand/grains with fingers and spoons; transfers grains, water (sponge, spoon) and objects (tongs) between containers.

nodes.label: Spoon & fork use
nodes.text: Uses a spoon with pincer grip; uses spoon and fork comfortably to eat.

nodes.label: Twisting lids, locks & caps
nodes.text: Twists lids to open and close; opens/closes lids and caps; lock-and-key activity.

nodes.label: Fastenings: buttons, zips, laces, velcro
nodes.text: Closes bag zip; buttons big buttons; works Montessori dressing frames (button, velcro, lacing, zipping); fastens/unfastens buttons with fingers.

nodes.label: Beading, threading & winding
nodes.text: Beads big then small beads; strings beads; winds thread on a spool; threads objects with a plastic needle; beads bracelets.

nodes.label: Paper crumpling & tearing
nodes.text: Crumples paper into a ball and tears paper using both hands.

nodes.label: Scissor skills
nodes.text: Uses scissors with ease to cut paper.

nodes.label: Sharpener & pencil-tool use
nodes.text: Uses a sharpener with ease; handles pencil tools.

nodes.label: Hand strength & pincer tools
nodes.text: Pin puzzles, U-pins, pegging, pounding, peeling peas and cracking nuts with strength.

nodes.label: Page turning & book handling
nodes.text: Turns pages of a book, holding the page from the corner, neatly one at a time.

nodes.label: Sorting & picking small items
nodes.text: Sorts grains; sorts and picks small items; sorts and matches objects (pincer precision).

nodes.label: Pencil grip & mark-making stage
nodes.text: Approaches and then uses a tripod grip when drawing and writing; grip/mark-making stage recorded each review.

nodes.label: Drawing lines, circles & copying shapes
nodes.text: Draws lines and circles with ease; copies basic shapes and patterns correctly.

nodes.label: Tracing patterns & pre-writing strokes
nodes.text: Traces patterns, lines and curves; standing/sleeping/slanting/curve/zig-zag strokes, with tripod grip.

nodes.label: Letter formation on four lines
nodes.text: Forms shapes resembling letters, then capital/lowercase letters with correct strokes, proportionally on a four-line notebook.

nodes.label: Number formation in square notebook
nodes.text: Traces numbers; aware of number strokes; writes numbers with correct strokes in a square notebook, extending the range each year.

nodes.label: Balance and coordination (sport)
nodes.text: Ability to maintain balance during activities (e.g., standing, running).

nodes.label: Agility
nodes.text: Speed and ease of changing direction (e.g., during obstacle courses).

nodes.label: Strength and endurance
nodes.text: Ability to sustain physical activities (e.g., football, running).

nodes.label: Speed
nodes.text: Ability to run or sprint in short bursts.

nodes.label: Coordination with equipment
nodes.text: Control over objects (e.g., kicking a ball in football, handling equipment).

nodes.label: Flexibility
nodes.text: Range of motion during stretching or obstacle course manoeuvres.

nodes.label: Reaction time
nodes.text: Speed of response in games like Freeze.

nodes.label: Spatial awareness (sport)
nodes.text: Ability to navigate space without collisions during group activities.

nodes.label: Grip strength
nodes.text: Ability to grasp and hold onto equipment (ropes, balls).

nodes.label: Hand-eye coordination
nodes.text: Ability to catch or throw a ball, or interact with small objects.

nodes.label: Dexterity
nodes.text: Handling small objects or equipment with ease (e.g., ball handling).

nodes.label: Foot-eye coordination
nodes.text: Ability to kick or control a ball with feet.

nodes.label: Managing bag, bottle & belongings
nodes.text: Puts shoes in the rack; arranges bag and bottles; opens and closes water bottles.

nodes.label: Dressing: socks, shoes, clothes
nodes.text: Removes and wears socks/shoes; folds clothes; hangs shirts and frocks.

nodes.label: Personal hygiene routines
nodes.text: Washes and wipes hands and mouth; proper use of handkerchief/blowing nose; combs hair and applies lotion; brushes teeth.

nodes.label: Mat & napkin care
nodes.text: Rolls, carries and folds a mat; folds and washes a napkin.

nodes.label: Cleaning: sweeping, mopping, wiping, dusting
nodes.text: Cleans the place after eating; sweeps and mops with small brushes; dusts a table; uses the dustbin.

nodes.label: Putting materials back & winding up
nodes.text: Understands wind-up; keeps materials/blocks back at their place; arranges books neatly on the rack.

nodes.label: Carrying a tray / objects without spilling
nodes.text: Carries a tray; carries water without spilling; carries a sharp object safely.

nodes.label: Gardening: soil, sowing, watering
nodes.text: Prepares soil and sows seeds; waters plants and picks up dead leaves.

nodes.label: Table setting & simple food preparation
nodes.text: Sets a table; prepares lemonade / fruit salad; washes and peels fruit.

nodes.label: Manners
nodes.text: Understands the concept of manners.

nodes.label: Greeting educators & friends
nodes.text: Greets educators and friends.

nodes.label: Queue & circle routines
nodes.text: Understands the concept of a queue and of a circle.

nodes.label: Good deed of the week
nodes.text: Participates in the weekly good-deed routine on the focus wall (PG-K2).

nodes.label: Pink Tower & Red Rods: size and length grading
nodes.text: Grades cubes by size (Pink Tower) and rods by length (Red Rods, concept of length).

nodes.label: Knobbed cylinders
nodes.text: Fits knobbed cylinders blocks 1 and 2 by dimension.

nodes.label: Colour recognition & colour tablets
nodes.text: Recognises and names primary and secondary colours; works primary/secondary colour tablets.

nodes.label: Five-senses sensorial materials
nodes.text: Mystery bag (see), tasting bottles, touch boards, smelling bottles, sound cylinders.

nodes.label: Auditory attention to environmental sounds
nodes.text: Responds to natural sounds (dry leaves, rain); recognises and recreates sounds heard in the environment; focused listening.

nodes.label: Sensory play: sand, water, bubbles
nodes.text: Engages with sand play and water play; observes bubbles and moves with them.

nodes.label: Block building & stacking
nodes.text: Stacks vertically; builds towers of 4+ blocks; understands blocks and their arrangements; creates with wooden blocks and rocks.

nodes.label: Froebel gifts: matching & sorting colours/textures
nodes.text: Matching and sorting in Froebel's gift of colours and textures.

nodes.label: Listens & responds to name, instructions, questions
nodes.text: Responds to own name; follows simple then 2-step instructions; listens and responds to directions and questions.

nodes.label: Listens & participates in stories
nodes.text: Listens and responds to stories narrated in class; participates during storytelling.

nodes.label: Conversational speech: words to sentences
nodes.text: Non-verbal communication and imitation of words; conversations using 4-6 words, then sentences; basic spoken grammar.

nodes.label: Expresses feelings & needs in words
nodes.text: Uses words to express feelings and needs; attempts to negotiate for personal needs.

nodes.label: Receptive & expressive vocabulary
nodes.text: Knows names of familiar people/body parts; points to named things and pictures; names items in a picture book; word of the week; uses vocabulary learnt in lessons.

nodes.label: Self-introduction
nodes.text: Gives a self-introduction.

nodes.label: Rhymes & songs: joins in and recites
nodes.text: Repeats actions and overheard words in rhymes; listens to rhymes in all languages; sings along and sings out loud a known rhyme/song.

nodes.label: Retelling events, stories & recounts
nodes.text: Retells things from day/week (accurately); retells stories using story map, puppets, pictures; retells a recount using actions.

nodes.label: Initiating conversation with adults & peers
nodes.text: Able to strike conversations with adults and children alike.

nodes.label: Drama: role play, acting out stories, skits
nodes.text: Engages in role play; acts out a story; aware of skit as an art form using expression, dialogue, dance and singing.

nodes.label: Initial & ending sounds
nodes.text: Identifies beginning and ending sounds; sees/hears and uses initial and ending consonant sounds; discriminates beginning from ending sound.

nodes.label: Rhyming words
nodes.text: Understands rhyming words.

nodes.label: Syllables & polysyllabic words
nodes.text: Understanding of syllable and polysyllabic rules (open/closed syllables; 2-3 syllable words).

nodes.label: Letter names & letter sounds Aa-Zz
nodes.text: Understands alphabet-sound concept; recognises upper- and lowercase letter names; sounds of individual letters; phonemes and graphemes.

nodes.label: Vowels & consonants
nodes.text: Differentiates vowels and consonants.

nodes.label: Blending & reading CVC words
nodes.text: Reads CVC words with short vowels; blends CVC words; blends vowels and consonants; reads 3+ letter words using sounds.

nodes.label: Consonant digraphs & silent-letter spellings
nodes.text: Recognises digraphs (ck, ll, sh, ch, ff, zz) in words and books; ch saying /sh/ and /k/; dge/ge saying /j/; gn/kn saying /n/.

nodes.label: Long vowels, vowel digraphs & r-controlled vowels
nodes.text: Long vowel sounds and digraphs (a, e, i, o, u); r-controlled digraphs (ir, er, ur, ar); y saying /igh/.

nodes.label: Adjacent consonants (CCVC/CVCC)
nodes.text: Understanding of CVCC and CCVC words; adjacent consonants.

nodes.label: Recognises own name in print
nodes.text: Recognises and spells own name; chooses own name card from a selection.

nodes.label: Environmental print & signs
nodes.text: Understands signs in the environment.

nodes.label: Sight words & tricky words
nodes.text: Reads two-letter sight words; understanding of sight words; tricky words lists.

nodes.label: Book handling & print concepts
nodes.text: Reads books front to back, page by page; left-to-right word reading; 1:1 finger-point matching; page numbers, front/back cover, title page.

nodes.label: Reading strategies: pictures to print
nodes.text: Uses pictures to predict; reads and comprehends a text without pictures.

nodes.label: Reading fluency & expression
nodes.text: Uses speech marks and punctuation to read speech in character.

nodes.label: Literal comprehension & recall
nodes.text: Answers factual questions about the text; passage comprehension; recalls information from the text.

nodes.label: Evaluative & inferential comprehension
nodes.text: Answers evaluative, extrapolative and value-based questions.

nodes.label: Story structure & text features
nodes.text: Beginning, middle and end of a story; features like commands, statements, rhyme and questions in a poem.

nodes.label: Text types & genres
nodes.text: Fiction vs non-fiction; recount text; genres (fantasy, mystery, poetry); novel, short story, story.

nodes.label: Sentence, journal & paragraph writing
nodes.text: Expresses thoughts in a journal; writes paragraphs.

nodes.label: Story composition
nodes.text: Makes own stories (oral), then writes own story.

nodes.label: Poetry writing
nodes.text: Writes chants, rhyming/shape/kenning/colour poems and new verses.

nodes.label: Non-fiction & functional writing
nodes.text: Writes instructions, information texts/reports, letters, invitations, summaries, advertisements and play-scripts.

nodes.label: Spelling & dictation
nodes.text: Listens and spells 3-letter words; dictation phonetically and spelling building (CVC and beyond).

nodes.label: Sentence structure & punctuation
nodes.text: Understanding of a sentence; punctuation; speech marks.

nodes.label: Parts of speech: nouns, adverbs, connectives
nodes.text: Nouns (name, place, animal, thing); adverbs; connectives.

nodes.label: Verb forms & suffix spelling rules
nodes.text: Uses -ing and -ed verb forms appropriately; adds -es / -ed / -ing to words ending in y.

nodes.label: स्वर एवं व्यंजन पहचान (vowel & consonant letter recognition)
nodes.text: Recognises and names individual स्वर (vowels) and व्यंजन (consonants) and tells them apart; foundational letter-shape recognition, before matras are introduced.

nodes.label: मात्रा ज्ञान एवं प्रयोग (matra recognition & use)
nodes.text: Recognises vowel-sign (matra) forms attached to consonants, reads and writes them correctly, and applies matras unaided in reading.

nodes.label: संयुक्ताक्षर पहचान (conjunct letter recognition)
nodes.text: Recognises and reads compound/conjunct letters (क्ष, त्र, ज्ञ, श्र and similar consonant-cluster forms).

nodes.label: शब्द पठन एवं पठन प्रवाह (word reading & fluency)
nodes.text: Reads 2-3 letter words, then words with matra/conjuncts, unfamiliar words, with growing fluency.

nodes.label: वाक्य/अनुच्छेद बोध (sentence & passage comprehension)
nodes.text: Understands 1-2 line sentences, then 3-4 and 5-6 line passages; inference and main idea.

nodes.label: अक्षर-मात्रा लेखन एवं हस्तलेख (letter formation & handwriting)
nodes.text: Forms swar with correct strokes on five lines; writes independently with correct matras and clear handwriting.

nodes.label: श्रुतलेख / वर्तनी (dictation & spelling)
nodes.text: Writes dictated words with correct matras and spelling.

nodes.label: वाक्य रचना / लेखन कौशल (sentence construction)
nodes.text: Constructs sentences of growing length and correctness.

nodes.label: अनुच्छेद / निबंध लेखन (paragraph & essay writing)
nodes.text: Writes 1-2 sentences about self, then 2-3 sentences on a topic, a 4-5 sentence paragraph, and an organised 5-6 sentence essay.

nodes.label: शब्दकोश (Hindi vocabulary)
nodes.text: Builds and uses Hindi vocabulary.

nodes.label: कविता एवं कहानी (Hindi rhymes & stories)
nodes.text: Learns new Hindi poems and stories; recites and retells.

nodes.label: मौखिक अभिव्यक्ति (Hindi speaking & oral participation)
nodes.text: Talks about pictures; speaks on a topic; active oral participation and dialogue in Hindi.

nodes.label: सुनने का कौशल (Hindi listening)
nodes.text: Listens and understands spoken Hindi.

nodes.label: हिंदी में गिनती और रंग (counting & colours in Hindi)
nodes.text: Colour names in Hindi; rote counting 1-10 in Hindi; Hindi numerals ० to १०.

nodes.label: व्याकरण: लिंग, वचन, काल (gender, number, tense)
nodes.text: Uses gender and number correctly; tense introduction; sentence structure.

nodes.label: शब्द भंडार: विलोम, पर्यायवाची, मुहावरे
nodes.text: Opposites, synonyms, idioms and proverbs.

nodes.label: Marathi letters & matras (मुळाक्षरे, स्वरचिन्हे)
nodes.text: Recognises Marathi letters and vowel signs; reads words without and with matras; barakhadi.

nodes.label: Marathi reading, vocabulary & oral
nodes.text: Reads/recites Marathi poems and stories; builds vocabulary; speaks about family, body, market, festivals.

nodes.label: Marathi writing & grammar
nodes.text: Writes numerals and words; grammar: वचन, विरुद्धार्थी, लिंग, विरामचिन्ह.

nodes.label: Verbal counting range (forward)
nodes.text: Counts verbally beyond 10, to 20, to/beyond 50.

nodes.label: Backward counting
nodes.text: Counts backward 10 to 1, 20 to 1, 30 to 1.

nodes.label: Number recognition range
nodes.text: Recognises numbers 1-20, then numbers to 150, to 1000.

nodes.label: Counting objects with 1:1 correspondence
nodes.text: Understands 1-1 correspondence; accurately counts items to 10, 20, 30; counts people in a room; counts objects to 100.

nodes.label: Finger numbers to 10
nodes.text: Shows finger numbers to 10.

nodes.label: Before / after / missing numbers
nodes.text: Tells after/before numbers in a sequence; before, after and missing numbers to 20; number sequences.

nodes.label: Number names
nodes.text: Number names 1-10, 11-20, 21-30; up to 100; 4-digit number names.

nodes.label: Counting in sets, skip counting & multiples
nodes.text: Counting in sets; multiples in 2s, 5s and 10s; skip counting.

nodes.label: Concept of zero
nodes.text: Understands concept of number 0 and demonstrates on the spindle box.

nodes.label: Ordinal numbers
nodes.text: Understands ordinals 1st to 10th; concept of ordinal numbers.

nodes.label: Odd & even numbers
nodes.text: Introduction to odd and even numbers; generalising odd and even.

nodes.label: Place value: hundreds, tens, units
nodes.text: Hundreds, tens and units place in numbers; reading/writing large numbers, partitioning.

nodes.label: Comparing & ordering numbers
nodes.text: Comparing numbers (equal, less, more) to 100; ascending/descending order; comparing and ordering quantities.

nodes.label: Rounding & estimation
nodes.text: Rounds to the nearest 10, 100 (and 1,000); estimates.

nodes.label: Addition
nodes.text: Addition through number line, quantities and counters; 2-digit then 3-digit addition with carrying; regrouping and reordering.

nodes.label: Subtraction
nodes.text: Subtraction through number line; 2-digit subtraction without and with borrowing.

nodes.label: Multiplication & times tables
nodes.text: Concept of multiplication; times tables of 1-5, 10; recall to 10x10; formal methods.

nodes.label: Division
nodes.text: Division through quantity (sharing/grouping); division using number lines and short division.

nodes.label: Mental maths & missing-number equations
nodes.text: Mental strategies (number bonds, doubling/halving, bridging); missing numbers in equations.

nodes.label: Fractions: part of a whole
nodes.text: Half and full; fraction as part of a whole; fractions of shapes; writing fractions numerically; fractions on number lines and as operators.

nodes.label: Calendar: days, months, dates
nodes.text: Says days of the week; understands calendar (date, day, month); identifies months; says/reads/writes date and days from the calendar.

nodes.label: Telling time
nodes.text: Reads o'clock time; tells time on wall clocks; what's the time; 12-hr and 24-hr formats.

nodes.label: Measuring length, mass & capacity
nodes.text: Length through non-standard units; standard units (cm) with a ruler; length, weight, capacity and time.

nodes.label: Money
nodes.text: Recognises coins and notes; totals and change; money word problems.

nodes.label: Temperature
nodes.text: Hot/warm/cool/cold; reads a simple thermometer; Celsius scale.

nodes.label: 2D shapes & properties
nodes.text: Recognises basic shapes; four basic shapes; 2D shapes up to octagon/trapezoid and their characteristics.

nodes.label: 3D shapes & properties
nodes.text: Solid shapes (cube, cylinder, sphere) via Froebel gift 2; 3D shapes and characteristics.

nodes.label: Position, direction & movement
nodes.text: Up/down, inside/outside; on/under/top/middle/bottom/beside; far/near; left/right; positions; turns and grids.

nodes.label: Symmetry
nodes.text: Understanding of symmetry; lines of symmetry; completing symmetrical figures.

nodes.label: Sorting, matching & classifying
nodes.text: Sorts shapes and colours; matches same objects; pairing; odd man out; groups/ungroups by characteristics; introduction to sets.

nodes.label: Patterns & sequencing
nodes.text: Sequences in a straight line; patterns with two in a sequence; patterns and logical sequencing; number patterns and rules.

nodes.label: Comparison of attributes
nodes.text: Big/small; tall/short; more/fewer; taller/shorter; full/empty; long/short.

nodes.label: Data handling: tally, Carroll diagram, charts
nodes.text: Carroll diagram and tally chart; data interpretation; pictograms and bar charts.

nodes.label: Probability & chance
nodes.text: Certain/likely/unlikely/impossible events; describing outcomes.

nodes.label: Everyday problem solving (puzzles, challenges, conflicts)
nodes.text: Finds hidden things; finds solutions to simple conflicts or puzzles; uses logic, reasoning and creative thinking to solve puzzles, navigate challenges and resolve conflicts.

nodes.label: Word problems
nodes.text: Concept of word problems; multi-step word problems using bar models.

nodes.label: Mathematical reasoning & explaining thinking
nodes.text: Estimates and checks answers; chooses operations; explains thinking with mathematical vocabulary; find-the-mistake.

nodes.label: Body parts, functions & skeleton
nodes.text: Names parts of the body and their functions; bones and skeletons.

nodes.label: Senses & sense organs
nodes.text: Aware of sense organs and their importance; senses and their function.

nodes.label: Healthy eating & diet
nodes.text: Healthy vs junk concept; fruits and vegetables and their purpose in our diet; balanced diet.

nodes.label: Safety & first aid
nodes.text: Understands safety measures; aware of first-aid use.

nodes.label: Animals: names, types & habitats
nodes.text: Names animals and birds; wild/domestic/aquatic characteristics and habitats; habitats (desert, forest, ocean...).

nodes.label: Plants: parts, needs & processes
nodes.text: Characteristics of plants; seed germination; parts of a plant and functions; what keeps plants alive; phototropism, transpiration.

nodes.label: Living & non-living; needs of living things
nodes.text: Characteristics of living and non-living; parameters that keep living things alive; basic needs of organisms; 7 rules of staying alive.

nodes.label: Fruits & vegetables: naming and types
nodes.text: Names vegetables and fruits; root and shoot vegetables.

nodes.label: Caring for the environment: compost, reuse, recycle
nodes.text: Compost and its purpose; composting, reuse, recycle, upcycle to protect the environment.

nodes.label: Seasons & weather
nodes.text: Characteristics of rainy season, winter, summer; understands seasons.

nodes.label: States of matter & changes (water cycle)
nodes.text: States of water; three states of matter; water cycle; solids, liquids, gases; melting and solidifying.

nodes.label: Mixing, dissolving, floating & sinking
nodes.text: Float and sink; soluble and insoluble; mixture, soluble, dissolve.

nodes.label: Forces & magnets
nodes.text: Magnetic and non-magnetic; forces to move/stop, speed up/slow down, change direction.

nodes.label: Materials & rocks
nodes.text: Types of rocks and their uses; natural and made materials, properties; materials, substances and particles.

nodes.label: Light, electricity & energy
nodes.text: Light sources and shadows; circuits and conductors; energy around us.

nodes.label: Earth, day & night, space
nodes.text: Sequence of the day; Earth and Moon; structure of the Earth, volcanoes, earthquakes; day and night.

nodes.label: Predict, test, analyse & record
nodes.text: Aware of predictions and results; predicts and analyses experiments and records them in the record format.

nodes.label: Discusses findings with teammates
nodes.text: Discusses findings with teammates.

nodes.label: Community helpers, professions & transport
nodes.text: City helpers and their roles; forms of transport; postman, librarian as professions.

nodes.label: Festivals, school events & special experience days
nodes.text: Takes part in school events and special experience days; aware of festivals and their significance.

nodes.label: Geography concept, earth surface & landforms
nodes.text: Geography as study of places/people-environment; earth surface land and water; land and water forms.

nodes.label: Maps: neighbourhood, India, continents & oceans
nodes.text: Neighbourhood places; continents and oceans on the globe; states and union territories of India.

nodes.label: History concept & passage of time
nodes.text: History as the story of the past; past, present and future.

nodes.label: Monuments & prominent personalities
nodes.text: Indian historic monuments and prominent personalities from the pre-independence era.

nodes.label: Culture, tradition & national identity
nodes.text: Understands the culture and tradition of the country; national symbols.

nodes.label: Computational thinking & logic
nodes.text: Computational thinking and logic.

nodes.label: Algorithms
nodes.text: Algorithms with real-life examples; writing algorithms with precision.

nodes.label: Debugging
nodes.text: Concept of debugging: identify and correct mistakes.

nodes.label: Bee-Bot programming
nodes.text: Bee-Bot functions and programming on simulator.

nodes.label: Block coding (Scratch, loops, events)
nodes.text: Coding and programming in Scratch; motion, loops, events.

nodes.label: Computer parts, hardware & digital awareness
nodes.text: Digital vs hard copy; identifying parts of a computer; hardware vs software.

nodes.label: Mouse & keyboard skills
nodes.text: Name typing; left and right clicks.

nodes.label: Data handling with tables & spreadsheets
nodes.text: Handling of tables and contents; presenting data in charts.

nodes.label: Networks, internet & online safety
nodes.text: Devices and connections; web, browsers, safety; purpose of networks.

nodes.label: Free drawing & mark-making
nodes.text: Scribbles in sand; finger paints/foam on mirror; draws free-form with crayons.

nodes.label: Painting techniques & brush control
nodes.text: Purposeful marks with a paintbrush; foam, wet-on-wet, splat, mural, spray painting; painting on different mediums; brush shapes and figures.

nodes.label: Representational drawing with detail
nodes.text: Symbolises faces/people/things; draws with increasing complexity and detail; memory drawing and vocabulary pictionary.

nodes.label: Art space, materials & tool care
nodes.text: Understands the space and material for art; takes care of tools and artwork.

nodes.label: Printing, imprints & dabbing
nodes.text: Generates imprints/impressions; dabs with various mediums; palm and finger prints; nature and magnet printing.

nodes.label: Product art & process art
nodes.text: Product art (Indian flag, hearts, themed art) vs process art (shapes with Q-tip).

nodes.label: Colour mixing & natural colours
nodes.text: Understands colour mixing; makes natural Holi colours; colour wheel.

nodes.label: Artists, art forms & appreciation
nodes.text: Piet Mondrian art; knows different art forms, art pieces and their artists; artist studies.

nodes.label: Exploring new tools & techniques
nodes.text: Straw-blow painting; team art; art to music; quilling, scratch art, silhouette; explores new tools in creative work.

nodes.label: Manipulating malleable materials
nodes.text: Moulds and manoeuvres clay: rolling, pressing, coiling.

nodes.label: Modelling shapes & forms in clay
nodes.text: Manipulates clay to create various shapes; basic sculpting techniques.

nodes.label: Gluing, sticking & constructing with craft materials
nodes.text: Glues (neatly) with glue/glue stick; creates shapes with popsicle sticks; shapes and buntings.

nodes.label: Collage
nodes.text: Understands and creates collage (e.g., kite).

nodes.label: Origami & paper folding/cutting
nodes.text: Folds origami paper to make a craft (boat, dog); paper cutting and symmetry.

nodes.label: Voice types & vocal qualities
nodes.text: Identifies different types of voices; singing/speaking/whispering/shouting voice.

nodes.label: Dynamics & pitch: loud and soft
nodes.text: Identifies loud and soft (pitch/dynamics).

nodes.label: Singing with rhythm
nodes.text: Sings with or without rhythm; sings rhythmically throughout a performance.

nodes.label: Beat & tempo: fast/slow, up-beat/down-beat
nodes.text: Fast and slow music beats; up-beat and down-beat.

nodes.label: Percussion instruments
nodes.text: Introduced to shakers, maracas, bells and other percussion instruments.

nodes.label: Music listening & appreciation
nodes.text: Mozart music listening circle; music as an art form to convey an idea via vocal or instrument sounds.

nodes.label: Moving & dancing to music and beat
nodes.text: Moves to beats and rhythms; slow and fast dance; animal dance; dances on beat/rhythm.

nodes.label: Dance with props
nodes.text: Dances with a prop (dupattas etc.).

nodes.label: Stretching & contemporary movement
nodes.text: Stretching and dancing on contemporary music.

nodes.label: Stitching as applied science; fabrics & sources
nodes.text: Stitching as practical application of science; types of fabrics and their sources.

nodes.label: Stitching tools, materials & etiquette
nodes.text: Basic stitching materials and tools; stitching etiquettes and purpose.

nodes.label: Stitching & weaving techniques
nodes.text: Running, whip, cross, blanket, back stitch; paper and loom weaving; embroidery; mending.

nodes.label: Cooking as applied science; measuring & mixing
nodes.text: Cooking as practical application of science; measuring and mixing as fundamental skills.

nodes.label: Kitchen safety, hygiene & tools
nodes.text: Kitchen safety, hygiene and basic kitchen tools.

nodes.label: Food knowledge: dairy, solids & liquids
nodes.text: Dairy products; ghee from butter; solids and liquids through cooking.

nodes.label: Independence in daily tasks & choices
nodes.text: Chooses preferred toys and people; increased desire to do things on their own; completes complex tasks independently.

nodes.label: Empathy & compassion
nodes.text: Observes emotions of others; understands and expresses concern; comforts friends; kindness.

nodes.label: Happiness & positive affect at school
nodes.text: Is excited and happy to come to school; separates easily.

nodes.label: Peer play: parallel to cooperative & teamwork
nodes.text: Excited with other children; plays beside then includes others; group play; cooperative play and collaborative projects; teamwork in sport.

nodes.label: Turn-taking & sharing
nodes.text: Takes turns; understands the word 'sharing'.

nodes.label: Pretend & role play skills
nodes.text: Make-believe play; elaborate pretend play with storylines, roles, props and costumes.

nodes.label: Understanding friendship
nodes.text: Understands what 'friends' / 'friendship' is.

nodes.label: Imitation & social learning
nodes.text: Copies others, especially adults and older children; tests and observes responses.

nodes.label: Naming & expressing emotions
nodes.text: Replicates/expresses emotions in the mirror; responds to 'Today I feel' chart; identifies and expresses a wide range of emotions; emotions via emoji art.

nodes.label: Coping with frustration & stress
nodes.text: Communicates feelings and copes with frustration; uses coping strategies for stress, frustration and disappointment.

nodes.label: Rules, fairness & social norms
nodes.text: Defiance as a 2-3 yr marker; respect for cultural and social norms; truth, fairness, honesty, cooperation; sportsmanship.

nodes.label: Resilience, persistence & risk-taking
nodes.text: Persistence in the face of challenges; confidence; willing to take risks, try new experiences and learn from failures.

nodes.label: Self-awareness & expressing preferences
nodes.text: Understands likes and dislikes; recognises self as an individual; expresses preferences, opinions and interests confidently.

nodes.label: Curiosity: enjoys new experiences & exploring
nodes.text: Ready to try new textures; enjoys new experiences and new situations.

nodes.label: Interest in Hindi language
nodes.text: हिंदी भाषा के प्रति रुचि.

nodes.label: Concentration & focus
nodes.text: Ability to stay focused during fine motor tasks (e.g., detailed games).

nodes.label: Effort & participation in sessions
nodes.text: Active participation in science, technology and sports sessions; willingness to try.

nodes.label: Responsibility & leadership in class roles
nodes.text: Takes responsibility in home period, assembly and class jobs (primary 'Leadership & Responsibility' trait).

nodes.label: Peace: calm inside & conflict resolution
nodes.text: Imagines a peaceful world; contrasts peace and violence; fills the self with peace; learns conflict-resolution skills.

nodes.label: Buddy or bully: anti-bullying
nodes.text: Understands what bullying is through scenarios; what to do to be a buddy; what to do if bullied.

nodes.label: Respect
nodes.text: Living Values unit on respect.

nodes.label: Honesty
nodes.text: Honesty is telling what really happened / the truth; keeping promises; honesty creates trust.

nodes.label: अक्षर जागरूकता (akshara & syllable awareness)
nodes.text: Hears and manipulates aksharas in spoken Hindi words: claps and counts aksharas, says a word without its first akshara, blends spoken aksharas into a word. Oral only, no print.

nodes.label: तुकांत एवं ध्वनि पहचान (rhyme & sound identification)
nodes.text: Recognises and produces rhyming words (तुकांत शब्द); identifies the first and last sound of a spoken word. Already carried informally by the Nursery-K2 Hindi rhyme repertoire.

nodes.label: वर्ण-विच्छेद एवं संयोजन (segmentation & blending in print)
nodes.text: Breaks a written Hindi word into its वर्ण and मात्रा and rebuilds it (कमल = क् + अ + म् + अ + ल् + अ); the print-level counterpart of akshara awareness and the bridge into decoding.

nodes.label: अनुस्वार एवं चंद्रबिंदु (nasalisation marks)
nodes.text: Reads and writes words with अनुस्वार (ं) and चंद्रबिंदु (ँ) -- हिंदी, अंदर, माँ, आँख. Very high frequency in Grade 1 text; currently first appears in the syllabus at Grade 2 inside a story lesson, after conjuncts.

nodes.label: नुक़्ता अक्षर (nukta letters ड़ ढ़ ज़ फ़)
nodes.text: Reads and writes ड़ and ढ़ (obligatory in native Hindi -- लड़का, पढ़ना) and then ज़, फ़ in everyday words. Currently first appears at Grade 4, three years after children meet these letters in print.

nodes.label: विसर्ग एवं तत्सम रूप (visarga & tatsama forms)
nodes.text: Reads words carrying विसर्ग (ः) -- दुःख, प्रातः. Low frequency, largely tatsama vocabulary; deliberately last in the sequence.

nodes.label: पठन प्रवाह मापन (measured oral reading fluency)
nodes.text: Reads unseen grade-appropriate Hindi text aloud, measured as correct words per minute with a comprehension check. Benchmarked against PARAKH FLS 2022 Hindi bands, not against a subjective impression of fluency.
